title: First instruments and trombone in a medicine show
summary: Braud began on violin and mandolin, played trombone in a Chicago medicine show in 1918, and was too young for the district.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Your first instrument was violin, is that right?
Violin and mandolin. Oh, man. And I played a little guitar. And in 1918, I played on a medicine show, Trombone, in Chicago. That's when I started my first
trombone day. Did you ever play in the district?
No, I was too young to go in the district. I couldn't go in the district when I was 18. You had to be 21.
